learner_persona: child learner building reading and language skills in the stated age band

certificate_wording: Mastemy Certificate of Completion — Phonics and Letter Sounds (Ages 5-7)

learning_outcomes.text: Recognise every letter of the alphabet in upper and lower case
Match each letter and common digraph to the sound it makes
Blend individual sounds together to read simple words
Segment spoken words into their separate sounds for spelling
Decode short sentences built from known letter sounds
Read common tricky words that do not follow regular spelling patterns

integrative_case: A young learner meets a new page in a picture book: sound out each regular word, recognise the tricky words by sight, and read the whole page aloud to a grown-up with confidence.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
does_not_assess: Assesses knowledge and applied reasoning through selection items; does not assess hands-on performance.
